entities.name: Query protein UbiE
observations: 260 aa protein; estimated molecular weight 27.55 kDa and theoretical pI 10.20.
Strong homology to reviewed UbiE proteins: up to 50.2% identity over 87.3% query coverage, E-value 4.69e-61.
Pfam Ubie_methyltran (PF01209.25) spans residues 32–255 with i-Evalue 1.6e-59.
Additional methyltransferase-domain matches include PF13489, PF08241, PF13649, and PF08242.
Likely SAM-dependent C-methyltransferase involved in quinone biosynthesis; exact substrate assignment is homology-based.

entities.name: UbiE
observations: Reviewed UbiE homologs catalyze methylation steps in menaquinone and ubiquinone biosynthesis.
Reported activities include demethylmenaquinone methyltransferase (EC 2.1.1.163) and 2-methoxy-6-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol methyltransferase (EC 2.1.1.201).
Uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine as the methyl donor, producing S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Associated with menaquinone biosynthesis, ubiquinone biosynthesis, and aerobic respiration.
